facts.fact: Tech Africa News reports that in February 2026 Paratus activated a 2,000-kilometre protected fibre route linking Mombasa to Goma via Nairobi, Kampala and Kigali, giving eastern DRC direct high-capacity access to subsea systems on the Kenyan coast; the document states capacity available and no traffic figures or named buyer.

systems.country_label: Mombasa to Goma protected fibre route
